name: SubDL Scribe
description: SubDL Scribe brings SubDL.com to Jellyfin: it downloads missing subtitles for the languages and libraries you pick and uploads your own. Download is on by default; upload is off — enable at your choice. Requires a SubDL login and API Key plus a TMDb API Key.
overview: Sync subtitles with SubDL — download missing and upload new subtitles.

versions.changelog:
v12.1.12.220: A DOWNLOAD dry run escapes the DOWNLOAD brake, not the search one. With the account
    at 50/50 the probe from F-M331 held back the very run meant to report what WOULD happen, so the
    dry-run test could not be started at all. A dry run fetches no file, so the download counter no
    longer stops it; the search allowance keeps holding it in both modes, because a dry run does
    search every item and prints only what those answers carry.
